+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from .utils import get_app_dir
+
+
+def get_profile_app_dir(
+    app_name: str, profile: str, roaming: bool = True, force_posix: bool = False
+) -> str:
+    r"""Returns the config folder for a named profile of the application.
+
+    This is the folder returned by :func:`get_app_dir` with ``profile``
+    appended as a subdirectory. For an app called ``"Foo Bar"`` and a
+    profile called ``"work"``, something like the following folders could
+    be returned:
+
+    Mac OS X:
+      ``~/Library/Application Support/Foo Bar/work``
+    Mac OS X (POSIX):
+      ``~/.foo-bar/work``
+    Unix:
+      ``~/.config/foo-bar/work``
+    Unix (POSIX):
+      ``~/.foo-bar/work``
+    Windows (roaming):
+      ``C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\Foo Bar\work``
+    Windows (not roaming):
+      ``C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Foo Bar\work``
+
+    The folder is not created.
+
+    :param app_name: the application name. This should be properly capitalized
+                     and can contain whitespace.
+    :param profile: the profile name. Must be a single, non-empty path
+                    component that is not ``.`` or ``..`` and contains
+                    neither ``/`` nor ``\``.
+    :param roaming: controls if the folder should be roaming or not on Windows.
+                    Has no effect otherwise.
+    :param force_posix: if this is set to `True` then on any POSIX system the
+                        folder will be stored in the home folder with a leading
+                        dot instead of the XDG config home or darwin's
+                        application support folder.
+    :raises ValueError: if ``profile`` is not a valid single path component.
+    """
+    if not profile:
+        raise ValueError("Profile name must not be empty.")
+
+    if "/" in profile or "\\" in profile:
+        raise ValueError(f"Profile name {profile!r} must not contain path separators.")
+
+    if profile in {".", ".."}:
+        raise ValueError(f"Profile name {profile!r} is not allowed.")
+
+    return os.path.join(
+        get_app_dir(app_name, roaming=roaming, force_posix=force_posix), profile
+    )
diff --git a/tests/test_profile_dirs.py b/tests/test_profile_dirs.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_profile_dirs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+import click.utils
+from click.profile_dirs import get_profile_app_dir
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def posix(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.utils, "WIN", False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.utils.sys, "platform", "linux")
+
+
+def test_xdg_config_home(posix, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", str(tmp_path))
+    result = get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work")
+    assert result == os.path.join(str(tmp_path), "foo-bar", "work")
+    assert not os.path.exists(result)
+
+
+def test_xdg_default(posix, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", raising=False)
+    assert get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work") == os.path.join(
+        os.path.expanduser("~/.config"), "foo-bar", "work"
+    )
+
+
+def test_force_posix(posix):
+    assert get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work", force_posix=True) == os.path.join(
+        os.path.expanduser("~/.foo-bar"), "work"
+    )
+
+
+def test_darwin(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.utils, "WIN", False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.utils.sys, "platform", "darwin")
+    assert get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work") == os.path.join(
+        os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support"), "Foo Bar", "work"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("roaming", "key"), [(True, "APPDATA"), (False, "LOCALAPPDATA")]
+)
+def test_windows(monkeypatch, tmp_path, roaming, key):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.utils, "WIN", True)
+    monkeypatch.setenv(key, str(tmp_path))
+    assert get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work", roaming=roaming) == os.path.join(
+        str(tmp_path), "Foo Bar", "work"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("key", ["APPDATA", "LOCALAPPDATA"])
+def test_windows_fallback(monkeypatch, key):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.utils, "WIN", True)
+    monkeypatch.delenv(key, raising=False)
+    roaming = key == "APPDATA"
+    assert get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work", roaming=roaming) == os.path.join(
+        os.path.expanduser("~"), "Foo Bar", "work"
+    )
+
+
+def test_matches_get_app_dir(posix):
+    assert get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", "work") == os.path.join(
+        click.utils.get_app_dir("Foo Bar"), "work"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "profile", ["", ".", "..", "a/b", "a\\b", "/abs", "\\abs", "work/", "..\\x"]
+)
+def test_invalid_profile(profile):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_profile_app_dir("Foo Bar", profile)
